newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Enersis to buy water firm - report.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Enersis to buy water firm - report.

text.p: Chilean power investment company Enersis has agreed to buy 55 percent of Santiago water utility Lo Castillo, reported newspaper El Mercurio Monday.
The paper did not say how much Enersis, which controls power firms Endesa and Chilectra, will pay for the shareholding.
Enersis is expected to hold a news conference Monday afternoon to give details of the deal.
Lo Castillo, a small private water company, supplies water to Santiago's wealthy eastern suburbs.
The company has come under heavy criticism recently for water supply problems resulting from the severe drought in central Chile.
